policyEnglish: Native marketing/build versions are independent of AOD core. Historical source values do not identify an accepted AOD artifact. Do not renumber them to imply core compatibility or import upstream history/configuration. A future release must seal exact core commit/version, reviewed native version/build, source inputs, locks, payload hashes and notices. Device, signing, install/upgrade/uninstall, rights review and explicit release authorization are separate gates.
policyChinese: 原生展示版本和构建版本独立于 AOD 核心。历史源码值不代表已验收的 AOD 产物。不得通过重编号暗示核心兼容性或导入上游历史与配置。未来发布必须绑定准确的核心提交与版本、经审查的原生版本与构建号、源码输入、依赖锁、载荷哈希和声明。设备、签名、安装升级卸载验收、权利审查及明确发布授权均为独立门槛。
